release_rules.patch: Add case, event, evidence, counterexample or stricter detector without breaking schema
release_rules.minor: Change compatible validation rules or controlled data fields
release_rules.history: Existing case metadata and historical events immutable; append events, add cases, bump release_version
release_rules.closed_means: Regression detected and repair observed only; zero future recurrence NOT certified

cases.title_ko: 신규 회계 문서 언어판 명명 누락
cases.title_en: New finance Markdown without language-edition marker
cases.root_cause: New markdown path lacked the mandatory _EN_KO.md suffix or a justified exception, while language-entry regression gated new documents.
cases.trigger: Addition of funding/GRANTS_CONTRACTS_PUBLIC_LEDGER.md to PI-RISE v0.2.0 draft.
cases.impact: PR #272 checks failed; publication blocked for that revision, not a research falsification.
cases.counterfactual: If the gate had not run, an edition-undeclared document could have been published unnoticed.
cases.repair: Renamed to funding/GRANTS_CONTRACTS_PUBLIC_LEDGER_EN_KO.md; registered bilingual inventory; reran CI.
limitations: Naming checks do not independently certify English/Korean semantic parity.
Historic failures remain historical and should not be deleted.

cases.title_ko: 병합 성공 후 회계 정본 소유권 경로 잔존
cases.title_en: Stale canonical ledger owner after successful merge
cases.root_cause: A human-maintained ledger_ownership pointer was excluded from the original manifest's artifact-path SHA checks; CI success implied insufficient coverage.
cases.trigger: Rename of finance ledger without updating operations/PI_RISE_V0_2_0_VERSION_MANIFEST.json ledger_ownership field.
cases.observable: institutional_grants_and_contracts pointed to nonexistent funding/GRANTS_CONTRACTS_PUBLIC_LEDGER.md while artifact list already referenced _EN_KO.md.
cases.impact: Published release manifest contained a dead canonical ownership reference despite passing CI.
cases.counterfactual: A reviewer trusting only the green CI result would infer the canonical path was reliable.
cases.repair: Corrected ledger_ownership to _EN_KO.md, added fail-closed publication/path/hash guard and updated manifest tracked checksums.
limitations: Structural/sha checks do not prove the underlying financial claims.
Protection from bypass requires branch rule configuration.

events.note: Observed stale ledger ownership pointer and missing target on main.
Tracked artifacts were individually hashed but ledger_ownership was not cross-checked.
Added 13 mutation/unit checks and canonical pointer validation.
PR 275 synthetic-only integrity workflow succeeded; 75 unit tests, including 13 new tests.
PR 275 merged; main manifest 13/13 tracked hashes matched in subsequent readback.

cases.title_ko: 경로 필터로 인한 CI 게이트 사각지대
cases.title_en: Path-filtered workflow could miss invariant-breaking PRs
cases.root_cause: Original pi-rise-integrity workflow was path-filtered; edits outside selected paths were not assured to run its global integrity invariants.
cases.trigger: Repository-wide invariants were treated as if only a few paths could invalidate them.
cases.observable: Older .github/workflows/pi-rise-integrity.yml had pull_request.paths and push.paths conditions.
cases.impact: A structurally green or skipped CI state was not sufficient evidence that cross-references stayed valid.
cases.counterfactual: Cross-document or future changes outside the allowlist could evade the relevant gate.
cases.repair: PR 275 removed restrictive path filters for PI-RISE. PI-FLR itself adds an unfiltered PR/main workflow contract plus mutation check.
limitations: Unfiltered CI runs can still be bypassed by repository settings, branch rules, admin privilege or workflow edits.
No zero-future-incident guarantee; main branch required-check enforcement not verified.

events.note: Review of prior PI-RISE workflow identified selective trigger paths.
Required-check execution coverage and changed-file coverage were incorrectly coupled.
Expanded PI-RISE checks to each PR and main push.
PR-triggered CI succeeded after trigger policy change.
New CI trigger merged; branch protection is separate unresolved governance control.
Cannot claim enforced required status checks or permanent recurrence prevention without branch settings verification.

cases.title_ko: E010 실험번호 재사용으로 별개 연구의 증거·사전등록 상태 충돌
cases.title_en: E010 identifier collision across unrelated blocked and published experiments
cases.root_cause: Two independent studies shared experiment identifier E010 without globally enforced provenance and uniqueness boundaries: the blocked 2026-10-06 safety-inspection draft and the published 2026-10-12 exploratory one-shot synthetic experiment.
cases.trigger: The unmerged historic PR #20 and main's E010 used identical experiment label while representing distinct constructions, results and validation status.
cases.observable: GitHub PR #91 explicitly documents P0 E010 identity collision. Published experiments/e010/README_KO.md distinguishes legacy PR #20 from 108-case posthoc result; experiments/e010/RESULT.json declares a different model and synthetic status.
cases.impact: Risk of attributing a blocked dynamic-inspection preregistration, prior-art or negative outcome to unrelated published E010, thereby misleading researchers about evidence and novelty.
cases.counterfactual: If historical design and modern E010 were merged on identifier alone, a green CI could fail to distinguish an unexecuted preregistration from a self-run exploratory synthetic result.
cases.repair: PR #91 separated lineage in canonical README and bilingual evidence registers; added governance CI to reject benchmark import, study model replacement, false preregistration or scientific status promotion. PI-FLR-C04 now independently replays those invariants in all-PR CI.
limitations: The detector protects this known E010 collision, not global uniqueness of all past or future experiment identifiers.
A GitHub PR claim and status guard are not scientific reproduction or empirical validation.
No information obtained from Gmail; this case was independently verified from GitHub sources.

events.note: Pull request identifies a P0 collision: legacy blocked safety-inspection E010 vs independently published exploratory E010.
Archived October 6 safety-inspection draft never produced a scientific E010 result; canonical E010 is a different model.
Bilingual source registry and E010 result identity protections introduced without combining experiment histories.
Original E010 analytic falsification/recorded-result workflow passed for PR #91 head.
PR #91 correction merged; blocked PR #20 remained separate and unmerged.
A corrected known identity collision alone does not establish repository-wide uniqueness or reliability of future identifiers.

improvement_protocol.invariant: No event removed and no root-cause or attribution silently rewritten; changed interpretations via appended notes and new version.
improvement_protocol.anti_proxy: CI pass is a limited code assertion, not proof of real-world truth, financial receipt, semantic parity, universal safety, or zero future incidents.
improvement_protocol.next_expansion: New cases should include adversarial tests for the original trigger and a test for the control itself; preserve counterexample with full evidence scope.
improvement_protocol.governance_gap: Branch protection/required checks and administrative bypass settings are not verified in this registry.
